$5$. A1

parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$y=\dfrac{x+3}{x-1}\Rightarrow yx-y=x+3$, or $x=\dfrac{y+3}{y-1}\Rightarrow xy-x=y+3$. *M1 Setting $f(x)=y$ or swapping $x,y$, clearing fractions and expanding brackets; allow sign errors.
$yx-x=y+3\Rightarrow x=\dfrac{y+3}{y-1}$, or $xy-y=x+3\Rightarrow y=\dfrac{x+3}{x-1}$. DM1 Finding the new subject; allow sign errors.
$f^{-1}(x)=\dfrac{x+3}{x-1}$. A1 OE; must be a function of $x$, not an equation $x=$.
Total: 3
